exposure: Patients with and without pre-ablation pain
Patients with and without tubal interruption
Patients with and without previous caesarean section
Patients with tubal ligation vs. salpingectomy
cohort: 324 patients who underwent endometrial ablation at a Melbourne tertiary hospital from 2009 to 2020
finding: Tubal interruption, pre-ablation pain, and previous caesarean section were associated with subsequent surgery for pain after endometrial ablation.
